(hr : Nat.Prime r) (hq : Nat.Prime q)
    (hs : Nat.Prime s) (ht : Nat.Prime t) :
    r * q = s * t ↔ (r = s ∧ q = t) ∨ (r = t ∧ q = s) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hdiv : r ∣ s * t := by
      rw [← h]
      exact dvd_mul_right r q
    rcases hr.dvd_mul.mp hdiv with hrs | hrt
    · have heq : r = s := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hr hs).mp hrs
      subst s
      exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, (mul_right_inj' hr.ne_zero).mp h⟩
    · have heq : r = t := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hr ht).mp hrt
      subst t
      have h' : r * q = r * s := h.trans (Nat.mul_comm s r)
      exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, (mul_right_inj' hr.ne_zero).mp h'⟩
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · rfl
    · exact Nat.mul_comm _ _

/-- Sorting removes the remaining swap ambiguity, including prime squares. -/
theorem ordered_prime_factors_unique {r q s t : ℕ}
    (hr : Nat.Prime r) (hq : Nat.Prime q)
    (hs : Nat.Prime s) (ht : Nat.Prime t)
    (hrq : r ≤ q) (hst : s ≤ t) (hprod : r * q = s * t) :
    r = s ∧ q = t := by
  rcases (prime_mul_eq_prime_mul_iff hr hq hs ht).mp hprod with
    hsame | ⟨hrt, hqs⟩
  · exact hsame
  · omega

open scoped ArithmeticFunction.Omega

/-- Mathlib's exact multiplicity-two predicate is equivalent to a product of
two primes. Repeated prime factors are allowed. -/
theorem isSemiprime_iff_exists_primes_mul {m : ℕ} :
    Nat.IsSemiprime m ↔
      ∃ r q : ℕ, Nat.Prime r ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ m = r * q := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hm, hΩ⟩
    change m.primeFactorsList.length = 2 at hΩ
    obtain ⟨r, q, hlist⟩ := List.length_eq_two.mp hΩ
    refine ⟨r, q, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList (n := m)
      simp [hlist]
    · apply Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList (n := m)
      simp [hlist]
    · simpa [hlist] using (Nat.prod_primeFactorsList hm).symm
  · rintro ⟨r, q, hr, hq, rfl⟩
    exact hr.mul_isAlmostPrime_two hq

theorem PrimeOrSemiprime.pos {m : ℕ} (h : PrimeOrSemiprime m) : 0 < m := by
  rcases h with hp | ⟨r, q, hr, hq, rfl⟩
  · exact hp.pos
  · exact Nat.mul_pos hr.pos hq.pos

theorem PrimeOrSemiprime.cardFactors_eq_one_or_two {m : ℕ}
    (h : PrimeOrSemiprime m) : Ω m = 1 ∨ Ω m = 2 := by
  rcases h with hp | ⟨r, q, hr, hq, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inl (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_apply_prime hp)
  · exact Or.inr (hr.mul_isAlmostPrime_two hq).2

@[simp] theorem not_primeOrSemiprime_one : ¬ PrimeOrSemiprime 1 := by
  intro h
  have hΩ := h.cardFactors_eq_one_or_two
  simp at hΩ

/-- The receiver-one case cannot be dropped from the `Ω ≤ 2` convention. -/
theorem cardFactors_le_two_iff_of_pos {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    Ω m ≤ 2 ↔ m = 1 ∨ PrimeOrSemiprime m := by
  constructor
  · intro hΩ
    have hcases : Ω m = 0 ∨ Ω m = 1 ∨ Ω m = 2 := by omega
    rcases hcases with hzero | hone | htwo
    · exact Or.inl
        ((ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero_or_one.mp hzero).resolve_left
          (Nat.ne_of_gt hm))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_eq_one_iff_prime.mp hone))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr
        (isSemiprime_iff_exists_primes_mul.mp ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt hm, htwo⟩))
  · rintro (rfl | h)
    · simp
    · rcases h.cardFactors_eq_one_or_two with hone | htwo <;> omega

/-- A direct bridge to mathlib's at-most-two predicate, including its exclusion
of zero and its inclusion of one. -/
theorem isAtMostAlmostPrime_two_iff {m : ℕ} :
    Nat.IsAtMostAlmostPrime 2 m ↔ m = 1 ∨ PrimeOrSemiprime m := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hm, hΩ⟩
    exact (cardFactors_le_two_iff_of_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm)).mp hΩ
  · intro h
    have hm : 0 < m := by
      rcases h with rfl | hreceiver
      · exact Nat.zero_lt_one
      · exact hreceiver.pos
    exact ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt hm, (cardFactors_le_two_iff_of_pos hm).mpr h⟩

def chenQuotientPrimeSource (N b : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (chenQuotientPrimeCarrier N b).image (fun P => (N - P) / b)

/-- Division is injective on these exact multiples, including the empty
zero-multiplier carrier. No assumption about squarefreeness is used. -/
theorem chenQuotientPrimeSource_injective {N b P Q : ℕ}
    (hP : P ∈ chenQuotientPrimeCarrier N b)
    (hQ : Q ∈ chenQuotientPrimeCarrier N b)
    (heq : (N - P) / b = (N - Q) / b) : P = Q := by
  obtain ⟨hPc, hPb⟩ := mem_chenQuotientPrimeCarrier.mp hP
  obtain ⟨hQc, hQb⟩ := mem_chenQuotientPrimeCarrier.mp hQ
  apply chenPrimeReceiverSource_shift_injective hPc hQc
  calc
    N - P = b * ((N - P) / b) := (Nat.mul_div_cancel' hPb).symm
    _ = b * ((N - Q) / b) := by rw [heq]
    _ = N - Q := Nat.mul_div_cancel' hQb

/-- Every quotient is positive and retains coprimality to the centre. -/
theorem chenQuotientPrimeSource_data {N b q : ℕ}
    (hq : q ∈ chenQuotientPrimeSource N b) :
    0 < q ∧ q ≤ N ∧ Nat.Coprime q N := by
  obtain ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
  obtain ⟨hPc, hPb⟩ := mem_chenQuotientPrimeCarrier.mp hP
  obtain ⟨hPN, _, hcop⟩ := mem_chenAdditivePrimeCarrier.mp hPc
  have hmul : b * ((N - P) / b) = N - P := Nat.mul_div_cancel' hPb
  have hpos : (0 : ℕ) < (N - P) / b := by
    apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    intro hz
    rw [hz, mul_zero] at hmul
    omega
  have hdiv : (N - P) / b ∣ N - P := by
    calc
      (N - P) / b ∣ b * ((N - P) / b) := dvd_mul_left _ _
      _ = N - P := hmul
  exact ⟨hpos, (Nat.div_le_self (N - P) b).trans (Nat.sub_le N P),
    ((Nat.coprime_self_sub_left hPN.le).mpr hcop).of_dvd_left hdiv⟩

@[simp] theorem chenQuotientPrimeSource_zero_multiplier (N : ℕ) :
    chenQuotientPrimeSource N 0 = ∅ := by
  classical
  have hc : chenQuotientPrimeCarrier N 0 = ∅ := by
    apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
    intro P hP

def chenY7PrimeSelector (N : ℕ) (D : ℝ) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ) :=
  (chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N ×ˢ chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N).filter fun t =>
    D ≤ (t.1 : ℝ) ∧ t.1 < t.2 ∧
    (t.2 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt ((N : ℝ) / (t.1 : ℝ))

/-- Actual eighth selector, including equality at the second lower cap. -/
def chenY8PrimeSelector (N : ℕ) (A C : ℝ) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ) :=
  (chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N ×ˢ chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N).filter fun t =>
    A ≤ (t.1 : ℝ) ∧ (t.1 : ℝ) < C ∧ C ≤ (t.2 : ℝ) ∧
    (t.2 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt ((N : ℝ) / (t.1 : ℝ))

/-- Actual ninth selector. Its quotient cutoff is kept separately below
and is not identified with the second prime. -/
def chenY9PrimeSelector (N : ℕ) (H D : ℝ) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ) :=
  (chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N ×ˢ chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N).filter fun t =>
    H ≤ (t.1 : ℝ) ∧ (t.1 : ℝ) < D ∧ D ≤ (t.2 : ℝ) ∧
    (t.2 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt ((N : ℝ) / (t.1 : ℝ))

    Finset ((ℕ × ℕ) × (ℕ × ℕ)) :=
  ((chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N ×ˢ chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N) ×ˢ
    (chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N ×ˢ chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N)).filter fun t =>
    A ≤ (t.1.1 : ℝ) ∧ t.1.1 < t.1.2 ∧ t.1.2 < t.2.1 ∧ t.2.1 < t.2.2 ∧

def chenY11FullPrimeSelector (N : ℕ) (A H D : ℝ) :
    Finset ((ℕ × ℕ) × (ℕ × ℕ)) :=
  ((chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N ×ˢ chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N) ×ˢ
    (chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N ×ˢ chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N)).filter fun t =>
    A ≤ (t.1.1 : ℝ) ∧ t.1.1 < t.1.2 ∧ t.1.2 < t.2.1 ∧
    (t.2.1 : ℝ) < H ∧ H ≤ (t.2.2 : ℝ) ∧ (t.2.2 : ℝ) < D

/-- Seventh support reindexing is exact even on squareful receivers. -/
theorem chenY7Tuples_eq_selector_filter {N P : ℕ}
    (hP : P ∈ chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N) (D : ℝ) :
    chenY7Tuples (N - P) (N : ℝ) D =
      (chenY7PrimeSelector N D).filter
        (fun t => ChenQuotient (t.1 * t.2) (t.2 : ℝ) (N - P)) := by
  classical
  have hn : N - P ≠ 0 := by
    have hPN := (mem_chenAdditivePrimeCarrier.mp hP).1
    omega
  ext ⟨p₁, p₂⟩
  rw [mem_chenY7Tuples_iff hn]
  simp only [chenY7PrimeSelector, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp₁, hp₂, hD, h₁₂, hcap, hQ⟩
    have h₁ := chen_prime_dvd_receiver_mem_additiveCarrier hP hp₁
      ((dvd_mul_right p₁ p₂).trans hQ.1)
    have h₂ := chen_prime_dvd_receiver_mem_additiveCarrier hP hp₂
      ((dvd_mul_left p₂ p₁).trans hQ.1)
    exact ⟨⟨⟨h₁, h₂⟩, hD, h₁₂, hcap⟩, hQ⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨⟨h₁, h₂⟩, hD, h₁₂, hcap⟩, hQ⟩
    exact ⟨(mem_chenAdditivePrimeCarrier.mp h₁).2.1,
      (mem_chenAdditivePrimeCarrier.mp h₂).2.1, hD, h₁₂, hcap, hQ⟩

/-- The seventh mean is an exact sum of actual quotient-source counts,
with the second prime still serving as its roughness cutoff. -/
theorem sum_chenY7_eq_siftedQuotientPrimeSource (N : ℕ) (D : ℝ) :
    (∑ P ∈ chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N, (chenY7 (N - P) (N : ℝ) D : ℝ)) =
      ∑ t ∈ chenY7PrimeSelector N D,
        ((chenSiftedQuotientPrimeSource N (t.1 * t.2) (t.2 : ℝ)).card : ℝ) := by
  calc
    _ = ∑ P ∈ chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N,
        (((chenY7PrimeSelector N D).filter
          (fun t => ChenQuotient (t.1 * t.2) (t.2 : ℝ) (N - P))).card : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro P hP
      rw [chenY7, chenY7Tuples_eq_selector_filter hP D]
    _ = _ := chen_sum_quotient_tuple_card_moving_cutoff N (chenY7PrimeSelector N D)
      (fun t => t.1 * t.2) (fun t => (t.2 : ℝ))

theorem currentChenUpsilon7_eq_siftedQuotientPrimeSource (N : ℕ) :
    currentChenUpsilon7 N =
      ∑ t ∈ chenY7PrimeSelector N ((N : ℝ) ^ (59 / 250 : ℝ)),
        ((chenSiftedQuotientPrimeSource N (t.1 * t.2) (t.2 : ℝ)).card : ℝ) := by
  exact sum_chenY7_eq_siftedQuotientPrimeSource N _

/-- Prime-divisor roughness, with the usual vacuous convention at `1`. -/
def ChenPrimeRough (y : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ q : ℕ, Nat.Prime q → q ∣ m → y ≤ (q : ℝ)

/-- The support of the manuscript's actual quotient indicator `Q_b(y;n)`. -/
def ChenQuotient (b : ℕ) (y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : Prop :=
  b ∣ n ∧ ChenPrimeRough y (n / b)

@[simp] theorem chenPrimeRough_one (y : ℝ) : ChenPrimeRough y 1 := by
  intro q hq hq1
  exact (hq.ne_one (Nat.dvd_one.mp hq1)).elim

/-- Literal finite support of `Y7`: `D ≤ p₁ < p₂ < sqrt(N/p₁)` and the
actual quotient by `p₁*p₂` is `p₂`-rough. -/
def chenY7Tuples (n : ℕ) (N D : ℝ) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ) := by
  classical
  exact (n.primeFactors ×ˢ n.primeFactors).filter fun t =>
    D ≤ (t.1 : ℝ) ∧ t.1 < t.2 ∧
